title: Halo Dental header
description: Transparent white-on-black top bar: a large emblem-and-name logo left, a quiet centred nav, a solid white squarish button and two see-through square tiles right. On phones: the button plus a square menu tile that opens a small dark panel.
notes: made to sit on top of halodental-opus-hero (overlay on); it always uses the theme's dark palette
the phone menu is a native <details> disclosure, no JavaScript
name: halodental-opus-header
